notes: Posted 26 June 2001, before Coruscant; the list has no Coruscant-set card, so the format is Premiere - Tatooine.

Starting cards as posted under 'Starting (11)': There Is Good In Him / I Can Save Him, I Feel The Conflict, Yarna d'al' Gargan, Tatooine: Podrace Arena, Boonta Eve Podrace, Endor: Chief Chirpa's Hut, Endor: Landing Platform (Docking Bay), Anakin's Podracer, Luke Skywalker, Jedi Knight, Luke's Lightsaber and Podrace Prep; these count toward the 60.

Posted 'There Is Good In Him/ Bop' dested the objective There Is Good In Him / I Can Save Him; 'Yarna Fat Lady' Yarna d'al' Gargan (the strategy's 'stay under 13 cards in hand'); 'Chirpa's Ghetto Pad' Endor: Chief Chirpa's Hut; 'Endor DB' Endor: Landing Platform (Docking Bay).
Posted 'Jedi Ultra Happy Luke' dested Luke Skywalker, Jedi Knight (the Jedi Luke the objective starts with) and 'Luke's Cutting Dealy' Luke's Lightsaber.

Posted 'Red Leader in' (under Starships) dested Red Leader In Red 1; 'Claw' Landing Claw; 'Anger Fear' Anger, Fear, Aggression (the strategy's 'AFA damage'); 'Projection OAS' Projection Of A Skywalker; 'OOC/TT' Out Of Commission & Transmission Terminated; 'Fallen Portalis' Fallen Portal.
The 'Interrupts (16)' section lists only 15 cards, so the total is 59 as published, not 60.
